description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the workflow: run `python3 scripts/scout.py --category ai,investing` from the news-scout directory to get JSON output with 16 mock items across 3 categories. 2. Agent processes the raw JSON: (a) identifies duplicate events (inv001 covered by Yahoo/CNBC/WSJ, ai001 covered by OpenAI/TechCrunch/Verge, cn001 covered by Baidu/机器之心) and deduplicates by keeping highest-priority source (P0 > P1); (b) adds '*(多家媒体报道)*' annotation to deduplicated items; (c) discovers the WSJ URL uses HTTP not HTTPS and either drops it (correct per dedup) or corrects it; (d) if WSJ is kept, adds '（可能需订阅）' annotation. 3. Agent selects exactly 10 items in 3:4:3 ratio (3 investing, 4 global AI, 3 China AI), ordered by hot_score descending within each section. 4. Agent formats output strictly per template: '## 🔥 新闻斥候简报 (YYYY-MM-DD)' title, three section headers (📈/🌍/🇨🇳), each item numbered with [⭐X] rating, *摘要* and *影响* fields, > 🔗 source link. 5. Footer must match '📊 本次共检索 {N} 条新闻 | 更新时间：HH:MM'. 6. File saved as briefing_report.md.
